tasks.label: validate-ps-parser-containerscripts
args: $files = @('ContainerScripts/Run-FkhBcTests.ps1','ContainerScripts/Invoke-FkhBcTests.ps1'); foreach ($f in $files) { $resolved = (Resolve-Path $f).Path; $tokens = $null; $errors = $null; [void][System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($resolved, [ref]$tokens, [ref]$errors); Write-Output "FILE=$f"; Write-Output "RESOLVED=$resolved"; Write-Output "TOKENS=$(@($tokens).Count)"; Write-Output "PARSE_ERRORS=$(@($errors).Count)"; if (@($errors).Count -gt 0) { foreach ($e in $errors) { Write-Output ("  LINE={0};COLUMN={1};ERRORID={2};MESSAGE={3}" -f $e.Extent.StartLineNumber, $e.Extent.StartColumnNumber, $e.ErrorId, $e.Message) } } else { Write-Output "  No parse errors." }; Write-Output "---" }
